text: Phase 1 replies/<key>.jsonl schema: { id: string, at: ISO, kind: 'reply'|'asked'|'error'|'stopped', name: string|null, space: string|null, text: string }. Backward compatible with legacy { at, name, text } (defaults: kind='reply', id=null, space=null). Engine writes .jsonl atomically/append-only FIRST, then .md (display-only). bh reply appends kind='reply' to .jsonl too. Turn ending on bh ask appends kind='asked' (text='') so chat.js clears waits[address] without posting a bubble or false silent note.

Step 1 engine side done per contract #1: replies/<key>.jsonl is append-only with {id,at,kind,name,space,text}; .jsonl written before .md; turns ending on bh ask append kind='asked' text=''; bh reply appends kind='reply' first; trim only past 400 via atomic rename; stripUnsafeEscapes on printed harness text; safeOn guards runner listeners. npm test 0 failures, bh check PASS.
